name: herdr-hud
description: A read-only HUD above the Claude Code prompt showing the agents running in Herdr (name, kind, status), refreshed every 2 seconds. Opt-in: herdr_delegate hands a read-only Codex review to a plugin-owned Herdr pane. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

delegate.title: Codex delegate
delegate.description: Register herdr_delegate / herdr_collect: Claude can hand a read-only code review to a Codex job in a Herdr pane this plugin owns. Uses your Codex account.

delegateMaxCalls.title: Delegate calls per session
delegateMaxCalls.description: How many reviews one Claude Code session may start.

delegateTimeoutMs.title: Review deadline (ms)
delegateTimeoutMs.description: How long a review may run before the job is marked timed out (the worker is not killed). 60000 to 1800000.

delegateCodexModel.title: Codex model
delegateCodexModel.description: Passed to codex exec -m when set; empty uses Codex's own default. Not validated against the installed Codex.
